## 中文说明
### 它解决什么问题

线上事故发生时的典型流程是：从日志里复制一段 traceback / pytest 输出 / `showmigrations` 结果粘到对话里，然后靠人眼找关键行。
这个过程有三个常见失败：抄错行号、
漏掉后面真正的根因、把"看不懂的日志"当成"已经看懂了"。
`dsh-py-doctor` 只做一件事：把这六类**已知语法**的报告文本解析成结构化 JSON，并且**如实报告它读懂了多少**。
### 为什么坚持离线

- **可复现**：同一段输入永远得到同一份输出。没有时钟、没有随机、没有网络，所以结论可以进 issue、进 CI、进复盘文档。
- **可审计**：工具不接触你的服务器，不需要 `settings

.py`、不需要数据库连接串、不需要 `-A proj`。粘文本就够了。
- **不失真**：不在本地跑一遍 Django 来"确认"，就不会引入第二套环境差异。
- **无副作用**：绝不 `mig
rate`、绝不发查询、绝不重启 worker。

### 六个工具
所有工具都在 `python` 组内，参数都是 `text`（报错原文，必填，内联粘贴）。返回值统一为回执信封：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| 工具 | 读什么 | 不读什么 |
| `python_traceback` | CPython traceback：异常类型/模块/消息、帧链、`__cause__`/`__context__` 链、SyntaxError 的插入符号
（caret）行号与列、`[Previous line repeated N more times]`、project 与 site-packages 帧、常见异常的根因提示 | 非 tracebac

k 的散文；截断的 `Traceback (most recent call last` 会被判为未识别 |
| `pytest_summary` | pytest 计数（passed/failed/
errors/skipped/xfailed/xpassed/warnings/deselected）、耗时、`FAILURES`/`ERRORS` 段落与 `E ` 断言摘要、`short test

summary info`、`--durations` 最慢用例 | 本次运行没打印的段落（在 `warnings` 里点名，不猜测） |
[该节后续省略]
### What it is

`dsh-py-doctor` registers six DeepSeek Harness tools that turn pasted Python/Django
production outpu

t into structured JSON. Every tool is a pure function of its input:
**no Python execution, no subpro
cess, no filesystem, no network, no clock, no randomness.**
| Tool | Input | Structured result |
| `python_traceback` | CPython traceback text | exception type/module/message, frame chain, chained
causes, SyntaxError caret line and column, elided recursion, project vs installed frames, root-cause

hints |
| `pytest_summary` | `pytest -q -ra --durations` output | counter totals, duration, failure

/error sections with `file:line` and `E ` excerpts, short-summary entries, slowest tests |
| `django
_migrations` | `manage.py showmigrations` / `--plan` | per-app applied and unapplied names, counts,

apps needing a plan, `(no migrations)` apps, `plan_needed` |
| `django_sql_n_plus_one` | `connection
.queries` dump, debug-toolbar SQL panel, `-v2` query log | normalized statement groups, N+1 candidat

es with count, verb, tables, first line and one original example |
| `django_checks` | `manage.py ch
eck` / `check --deploy` | one finding per issue with level, diagnostic id, message, hint, best-effor

t object, per-severity counts, deploy items, summary line |
| `celery_report` | `celery inspect acti
ve/reserved/ping/stats` | workers with task lists, task histogram, reserved tasks, scalar facts |
### Why offline only

Reproducibility and auditability. The same paste always produces the same JSON, so a
diagnosis can b

e pasted into an issue, a CI log, or a post-mortem. Nothing needs your
`settings.py`, a database URL

, or `-A proj`; nothing can migrate, query, or restart a
worker as a side effect of asking a questio

n. The cost is explicit: this plugin will
never confirm a hypothesis by running your code.
